sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-instruction: Look at the forms of transport then ask your partner:
sourceTexts.sb20-transport-labels: aircraft · cable car · cruise ship · ferry · hot-air balloon · hovercraft · motorbike · scooter · helicopter
sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-1: 1- How many means of transportation can you see?
sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-2: 2- Which transport do you like to travel by?
sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-3: 3- In your opinion,what is the best way to travel ? Why?
sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-4: 4- Which one would be the fastest/the cheapest/ the most comfortable/ the safest?
sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-example: For example: I think the fastest way to travel across a large city would be by scooter. I agree / I don’t agree: I think travelling by a ferry is the safest.
sourceTexts.sb20-speaking-5: 5- What do you usually pack when you go away for a short trip?
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-instruction: Read the following text then do the tasks below.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-1: People need to interact and communicate with others. Travel is a means of amusement and enjoyment that allows interaction among people.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-2: I would like to share with you a journey to Spain accompanied by my family.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-3: The tourist company had done an amazing job. It organized the trip and confirmed the dates and places that we were going to visit in Spain. Our flight tickets showed that we needed two hours to reach our destination, which is about 800 kilometers.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-4: Upon arrival, a bus was waiting to drive us to the hotel. We enjoyed the beautiful views and lots of amazing things on our way to the hotel. We passed through a mountainous area with many high volcanic mountains. After checking in our rooms, we headed to a small restaurant which served delicious traditional food.The view from the restaurant was great.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-5: During the three-day trip,we visited various ancient sites and old markets and we bought nice souvenirs for our friends.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-6: Besides, we met people from different nationalities and we learnt about various traditions and cultures. That amazing trip has increased our knowledge about the world.
sourceTexts.sb21-reading-7: At the end of the trip, we thanked the trip supervisor and the tourism company for their great efforts.

sourceTexts.sb23-perfect-title: Revision of Present Perfect Tense: Find Somebody Who...............
sourceTexts.sb23-perfect-instruction: - Ask your classmates questions using the present perfect tense and complete the table.
sourceTexts.sb23-example-question: For example, Have you been to another country?
sourceTexts.sb23-phone-intro: It’s a bad phone line and we could only hear a few sentences of Jerry’s phone call.
sourceTexts.sb23-phone-call: “I’m sitting in a train station in New Delhi but I don’t have a lot of time. I don’t have a laptop here so I can’t check my email every day. I’ll call you when I find a room with Wi-Fi. I’ve tried so many new kinds of food here in India. I’ve eaten spicy food and it is delicious. I’m going to travel to Egypt next week to see the Pyramids. I miss you!”
sourceTexts.sb23-report: Jerry said that he was sitting in a train station in New Delhi but he didn’t have a lot of time. He told his friend that he didn’t have a laptop there so he couldn’t check his email every day. He would call his friend when he found a room with Wi-Fi. He said that he had tried so many new kinds of food there in India. He had eaten spicy food and it is delicious. He added that he was going to travel to Egypt the week after to see the Pyramids. At the end of the call he told his friend that he missed him.

sourceTexts.wb10-header: Module 2 · Unit 3 · Let’s Discover · Journeys Around the World
sourceTexts.wb10-speaking-instruction: - Work in pairs. Discuss these questions.
sourceTexts.wb10-speaking-a: A- When you travel abroad, do you try to learn about the place/ culture/ language? Why?
sourceTexts.wb10-speaking-b: B- Do you enjoy visiting tourist areas/ old cities/ new cities? Why?
sourceTexts.wb10-reading-instruction: - Read the following text and do the tasks below.
sourceTexts.wb10-reading-1: Last summer, my family and I had the opportunity to travel and discover the beautiful continent of Australia.
sourceTexts.wb10-reading-2: It was not an easy choice among the other beautiful places in the world, but this country has always fascinated us with its culture. In fact, Australia is one of the richest continents and is also one of the largest countries in the world. It is located in the southern hemisphere, and all its states use the Australian dollar. Australian English is the national and popular language of the country. It is similar to English in grammar and spelling with some notable exceptions.
sourceTexts.wb10-reading-3: When my parents learned about wonders of Australia that awaited us, them immediately bought airline tickets.
sourceTexts.wb10-reading-4: We woke up early in the morning to catch a direct flight to Australia. The flight lasted about 20 hours. Finally, we arrived in Sydney and settled in a hotel.
sourceTexts.wb10-reading-5: The next day, we visited the Opera House which had a beautiful architecture. It was a perfect day. In the afternoon we went to Taronga Zoo to see the famous Australian animals like kangaroos and koalas. The following days, we enjoyed the beaches, shopping centers and beautiful museums of Sydney. Unfortunately, we had to prepare our luggage to return home to Montreal before I could realize that our seven-day vacation had already passed.

sourceTexts.wb12-title: Grammar · Revision of the present perfect tense
sourceTexts.wb12-perfect-intro: The present perfect tense is used to express:
sourceTexts.wb12-rule-1: - an event that started in the past and the effect of the event is now continuing.
sourceTexts.wb12-rule-2: - an event that started in the past and is still going on.
sourceTexts.wb12-form-affirmative-text: I, you, we, they have seen / He, she, it has seen
sourceTexts.wb12-form-negative-text: I, you, we, they haven’t seen / He, she, it hasn’t seen
sourceTexts.wb12-form-interrogative-text: have I, you, we, they seen the film? / has he, she, it seen?
sourceTexts.wb12-a-instruction: A - (Put the verbs into the correct form (present perfect tense.
sourceTexts.wb12-a-example: e.g. We (buy) have bought a new lamp.
sourceTexts.wb12-perfect-2: 2- Where (you / be).................? I haven’t seen you for ages.
sourceTexts.wb12-perfect-3: 3- She (not / see) ..................him for a long time.
sourceTexts.wb12-report-intro: When we tell someone what another persone said we use reporting verbs like: (said , told),and we do the following changes to:
sourceTexts.wb12-report-1: She said (that) she liked ice cream.
sourceTexts.wb12-report-2: She said (that) she was working in London.
sourceTexts.wb12-report-3: She said (that) she hadn’t seen Julie.
sourceTexts.wb12-b2: 2- He said (we, he) was going to Canada.
sourceTexts.wb12-b3: 3- They said they (spent, spend) a nice holiday.
sourceTexts.wb12-b4: 4- They told me that they (took, take) (they, their) grandchildren on holiday.
